text_en: To the leader: with stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph. A Song.
text_cn: 阿撒夫的诗歌。交与乐官，乐用弦乐。

text_en: In Judah God is known, his name is great in Israel.
text_cn: 天主在犹大地显示了自身， 在以色列广扬了自己的名。

text_en: His abode has been established in Salem, his dwelling place in Zion.
text_cn: 他在撒冷支搭了自己的帐幕， 他在熙雍建竖了自己的住处。

text_en: There he broke the flashing arrows, the shield, the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah
text_cn: 在那里他打断了弓上的火箭， 他也打断了枪柄、盾牌与刀剑。（休止）

text_en: Glorious are you, more majestic than the everlasting mountains.
text_cn: 大能者，你大发光明， 是来自远古的山陵。

text_en: The stouthearted were stripped of their spoil; they sank into sleep; none of the troops was able to lift a hand.
text_cn: 胆大的人，全被剥夺，一睡不醒， 那勇敢的将领，手臂麻木失灵。

text_en: At your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both rider and horse lay stunned.
text_cn: 雅各伯的天主，因你的恐吓， 战车战马都惊得麻木僵直。

text_en: But you indeed are awesome! Who can stand before you when once your anger is roused?
text_cn: 你尊严可畏；你盛怒时， 何人能在你面前站立？

text_en: From the heavens you uttered judgment; the earth feared and was still
text_cn: 你由天上宣布判案， 大地战栗默默无言。

text_en: when God rose up to establish judgment, to save all the oppressed of the earth. Selah
text_cn: 因为天主起来施行审判， 是要救世上的一切贫贱。（休止）

text_en: Human wrath serves only to praise you, when you bind the last bit of your wrath around you.
text_cn: 人的狂怒成全你的光荣， 幸免愤怒的人，向你祝颂。

text_en: Make vows to the Lord your God, and perform them; let all who are around him bring gifts to the one who is awesome,
text_cn: 你们许愿要向上主你们的天主还愿； 他四周的人都要向可敬者供奉祭献。

text_en: who cuts off the spirit of princes, who inspires fear in the kings of the earth.
text_cn: 他抑压首领们的气焰， 他使地上的众王抖颤。
